messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (5m spike, ~18% errors). Paging oncall.
jordan (eng-oncall): acked, jumping on. seeing latency increase on dashboard too. paging SRE.
priya (sre-oncall): oncall here. pulling up traces and LB stats now. can someone post recent deploys?
marta (prod-eng): pushed a small LB route tweak 40m ago to change route weighting and add a retry policy for legacy models — commit: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/ab12cd3
priya (sre-oncall): looking at envoy stats: cluster: model-backend has large 5xx and 502 spikes. envoy upstream_retries is spiking. logs show a retry loop causing backend overload.
priya (sre-oncall): quick summary: errors are upstream 502/503, and Envoy is configured to retry on 5xx — causing amplification. requests/sec to a subset of backends doubled. impact: ~15% of user-facing requests in us-west-2 failing/timeout.
jordan (eng-oncall): yikes. 15% is visible on the customer dashboard. support-lead please stand by for comms.
support-lead: standing by. drafting a brief status note if we confirm mitigation path.
alex (infra): if retries are the amplifier, we should disable retries at the gateway and/or reduce retry_count to 0 while we stabilize. also can temporarily relax upstream circuit-breaker thresholds (max_connections) to prevent conn rejections.
priya (sre-oncall): agree. plan: 1) disable retries on gateway route 2) increase circuit breaker max connections for affected cluster 3) rollback the recent route-weight change if needed. I'll do (1) and (2) now.
priya (sre-oncall): running patch (kubectl patch configmap envoy-gateway -n infra --type merge -p '"{"data":{"route_retry_count":"0"}}"') — this is a configmap -> xds path; infra-deploy will pick up.
infra-deploy-bot: Received config change. Applying xDS push for envoy-gateway configmap.
infra-deploy-bot: xDS push complete to 120 proxies in us-west-2.
priya (sre-oncall): verifying metrics...
priya (sre-oncall): immediate drop in envoy retry_count metric. upstream 5xx still high but not amplifying. retry amplification reduced.
jordan (eng-oncall): good. any change in user error rate yet?
priya (sre-oncall): user 5xx dropped from 18% -> 9% in 4m. still above baseline (~1%). next: increase cb thresholds by +50% for the affected cluster to reduce rejects and let backends drain.
alex (infra): doing cb change now. command:
```
kubectl -n infra exec -it envoy-control -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/circuit_breakers -d '{"cluster":"model-backend","max_connections":600}'
```
alex (infra): response OK. pushing new limits.
infra-deploy-bot: circuit-breaker update propagated to 60 proxies.
priya (sre-oncall): monitoring... user 5xx down to 3% after cb change and retry disable. latency normalizing. good signal.
marta (prod-eng): i'm locking the route-weight change PR and starting a rollback PR for that commit (ab12cd3). won't merge until we confirm stable.
jordan (eng-oncall): support-lead — can you post a short status line on status.redwood.com: "partial errors for text-generation in us-west-2; mitigation in progress; some requests may have failed or been delayed" ?
support-lead: posting now. pinging top affected customers via support queue.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigation actions applied (retries disabled, cb relaxed). Keep monitoring for 30m.
priya (sre-oncall): handing off to alex for post-mitigation monitoring and next steps. I'll stay available for rollback if needed.
alex (infra): taking over monitoring. notes: retries disabled at gateway, circuit-breaker increased, route-weight rollback PR open but not merged. watching error rate, backend health, and CPU on model nodes.
alex (infra): setting an alert: if 5xx > 2% for 10m, page SRE and infra.
priya (sre-oncall): post-incident todo: 1) revert aggressive retry policy in config repo 2) add automated guardrail to prevent retry-on-5xx for model routes 3) postmortem and customer impact timeline 4) test harness for route-weight changes in staging.
marta (prod-eng): noted. i'll own (1) and (4). will coordinate with QA for staging test.
support-lead: updated status: "Mitigation applied. Reduced error rates observed. Engineers continue monitoring; detailed postmortem to follow." sent to customers.
jordan (eng-oncall): thanks everyone. Alex — take it from here. Priya — thx for the fast runbook.
alex (infra): thanks — will keep the thread updated. current thread metrics snapshot: 5xx=1.7% (down), retries=0, avg latency=220ms. holding for 35m then will close if stable.
priya (sre-oncall): ack. leaving handoff at 2140009012.
incident-bot: INCIDENT REMINDER: Postmortem required for severity P2 if customer impact >10% or >30m. Marking for follow-up.
